## reliable-deer

### Description and Rationale
I'm a master's student at QMUL and my machine learning professor (Dr Jun Chen) got me interested in the problem of taxi times at airports and the problems/delays that arise due to this. I came across this competition trying to study (and possibly solve) this problem and it got me instantly interested.
